title: PhD alumni
text:
Earlier doctoral programmes
Before 2018 doctoral training in statistics at Milano-Bicocca ran through other programmes: Statistics, Statistics and Applications, and Statistics and Mathematical Finance (statistics curriculum only). The list covers the theses deposited in the BOA institutional repository from 2010 onwards. Supervision is taken from the title page of each thesis; where the title page names only a tutor, the tutor is listed as supervisor. Current positions in Italian universities come from the MUR register of academic staff; the others are still to be completed.
